forcedChoices.reason: Short-scale billion; 3 million x 1000 minor sectors.
'su sector menor' would read as 'their sector' (the controllers').
'control mental' reads as control of minds, not control by mind.
Keeps both the necessity and the inference reading of 'must'; 'deben de' would close it to inference.
Bare 'positivas/negativas' adds a sense of good and bad.
'tipos' alone is ambiguous (types/kinds); the English 'adjustable type' is printing type.
Spanish 'sus' keeps the English 'their' (the Master Spirits) without adding a name.
